claim_text: A method for reducing the risk of lead fracture in an implantable defibrillator, comprising: A) a polymer-jacketed, single-filar, high-strength alloy conductor; and B) a design that minimizes mechanic

workarounds.description: Replace the polymer jacket with a thin, flexible metal sleeve, such as a titanium or stainless steel tube, to provide mechanical support and protection to the conductor.
workarounds.value_preservation_analysis: The competitor still achieves the commercial value of the invention by reducing the risk of lead fracture, but with a different material and design approach.

workarounds.description: Use a multiple-filar conductor instead of a single-filar conductor, which can provide increased strength and flexibility without the need for a polymer jacket.
workarounds.value_preservation_analysis: The competitor still achieves the commercial value of the invention by reducing the risk of lead fracture, but with a different design approach that does not require a polymer jacket.

workarounds.description: Minimize mechanical stress on the conductor by using a more flexible lead design, such as a coiled or spiral design, which can absorb and distribute mechanical stress more effectively.
workarounds.value_preservation_analysis: The competitor still achieves the commercial value of the invention by reducing the risk of lead fracture, but with a different design approach that does not require a polymer jacket or multiple-filar conductor.

workarounds.description: Use a composite material that combines the benefits of a polymer jacket and a high-strength alloy conductor, such as a fiber-reinforced polymer matrix composite.
workarounds.value_preservation_analysis: The competitor still achieves the commercial value of the invention by reducing the risk of lead fracture, but with a different material and design approach that combines the benefits of multiple technologies.

workarounds.description: Design the lead to eliminate mechanical stress altogether by using a self-supporting design, such as a self-expanding lead that can maintain its shape and position within the body.
workarounds.value_preservation_analysis: The competitor still achieves the commercial value of the invention by reducing the risk of lead fracture, but with a different design approach that eliminates the need for a polymer jacket or multiple-filar conductor.
